author: /root/grounding_route_audit
scope: Evidence-only class discovery. No trait records, IDs, shared code, schemas, Git/GitHub, goals or sessions changed. These are known published classes missing from PTM, not newly proposed scientific structures.
candidate_status_rule: Class acceptance, runnable-screen availability, source rights and protein-occurrence qualification are separate decisions. A PDB anchor is not a qualified canonical example; no residue coordinates are promoted here.

collision_evidence.interpretation: No exact beta-arch/Asx-turn/ST-turn aliases were found in the scanned data/traits, data/raw, data/curation, data/mappings or docs/data files. Research matches are planning/context, not class records. Beta-architecture and first-turn substring matches in the initial scan were false positives.

exact_curie_scan.command: rg -l --no-ignore --hidden 'SO:0000912|SO:0001141|BS:00203|BS:00231' data/traits data/raw data/curation data/mappings docs/data research -g '*.yaml' -g '*.json' -g '*.tsv' -g '*.obo' -g '!research/structural-discovery-20261028/motifs/**'

accepted_class_candidates.label: beta arch
accepted_class_candidates.identifier_action: Root must apply native reservation if selecting this class. No internal identifier assigned by this audit.
accepted_class_candidates.ontology_search: Current official SO data-version 2026-08-07 has no beta-arch name or synonym match. Broader web searches did not establish another exact CURIE; this is not a universal ontology absence claim.
accepted_class_candidates.definition_proposal: A supersecondary motif in which two successive beta strands are connected by a segment and do not hydrogen-bond to one another as a beta-hairpin pair.
accepted_class_candidates.scope_note: The connecting segment is the beta-arc/loop; the whole strand-connection-strand unit is the beta-arch. Do not make beta-arc or bare beta-beta exact synonyms of the full motif. A beta-arch need not contain only coil; the cited design study also describes helix-containing connections.
accepted_class_candidates.source_rights: CC-BY-4.0 explicitly stated in the article. Chidyausiku et al. 2022; attribution and indication of paraphrase required.
inspected_locations: Methods: Structural analysis of beta-arch loops

detection.local_availability: /opt/homebrew/bin/mkdssp exists; this audit did not execute a motif detector
detection.classification_after_screen: Enumerate connected successive strand segments in one continuous chain; inspect their strand-pairing/hydrogen-bond assignments and reject paired beta-hairpins. Confirm the complete strand-connection-strand geometry in coordinates. Missing backbone atoms, chain breaks or ambiguous secondary assignments remain unresolved.
detection.source_sampling_not_class_definition: The study selected loops shorter than 9 residues; do not impose that as a universal beta-arch length cutoff.
detection.limit: DSSP itself emits assignments and hydrogen-bond information, not a beta-arch call. A retained class filter or explicit manual discrimination remains required. No local execution/classifier validation claimed.

structure_anchor.source_assertion: The paper reports that the designed beta-arch loop and beta-arch helix are reproduced across dIG8-CC crystal monomers.
structure_anchor.archive_crosscheck: 7SKO is dIG8-CC, chains A/B/C/D. Alternative 7SKN is dIG8-CC at 2.30 A. Figure5's 7SKP/chainC caption conflicts with the archive: 7SKP is dIG14 with chains A/B. Do not derive coordinates from that caption.
structure_anchor.qualification: Representative structure only; no sequence, residue bounds, UniProt mapping or source-qualified occurrence asserted.

remaining_blockers: Execute and retain the chosen screen/manual or complete detector route before claiming tested detection

accepted_class_candidates.label: Asx turn
accepted_class_candidates.identifier_action: Use the exact external class under native policy; do not mint an internal surrogate.
accepted_class_candidates.definition_proposal: A three-residue structural motif whose first residue is aspartate or asparagine and whose side-chain oxygen accepts a hydrogen bond from the backbone NH of the third residue.
accepted_class_candidates.parent_caveat: SO places it under SO:0001128. Native proteintraitsmech:TURN now denotes DSSP T-state and is not a valid equivalent parent for all side-chain turns.
accepted_class_candidates.source_rights: SO is CC-BY-4.0; official LICENSE inspected and retained. The compatible BMC2009 resource paper and its SQL supplement are CC-BY-2.0. Keep their original attribution/license, rather than relabeling the sources.
accepted_class_candidates.identity_boundary: Existing proteintraitsmech:ASX_MOTIF is a five-residue, two-hydrogen-bond class. Some instances contain an Asx turn, but the classes are not equivalent.

detection.output: Input-basename .hb2 hydrogen-bond listing in the tool working directory; preserve input and output provenance.
detection.version_documented: Official EBI page identifies v3.06; actual installed build must be recorded when run.
detection.class_filter: Require one continuous three-residue chain segment starting in ASP/ASN and a side-chain oxygen acceptor to main-chain N-H donor bond at i+2. Handle alternate conformers, missing atoms, Asn orientation and author/insertion numbering explicitly. A mere D/Nxx sequence match is insufficient.
detection.subtype_filter: The published supplement contains eight Asx-turn SQL queries separating Asp/Asn and four dihedral variants. Those queries are executable only against the defined Protein Motif Database tables, not directly against a PDB file.
detection.local_status: hbplus and reduce absent. Official manual retains academic confidentiality/copying restrictions despite current EBI free-download wording; software reuse terms need resolution before installing/redistributing. No execution claimed.
detection.alternative: An independently implemented, source-cited hydrogen-bond geometry screen with explicit manual confirmation could satisfy the native route without importing HBPLUS code; root must implement/test it if chosen.

structure_anchor.source_assertion: The original authors' resource explicitly illustrates an Asx turn at the alpha-amylase active site in 1VJS.
structure_anchor.rights_boundary: The resource example is inspected factual context; its independent website/database data license was not established. Do not import its graphics or coordinate annotations under the BMC article license by assumption.
structure_anchor.qualification: Archive-linked representative candidate only; P06278 is an archive cross-reference, not a release-pinned trait occurrence. No residue bounds promoted.

remaining_blockers: Runnable class-specific hydrogen-bond screen not executed
Website example-rights and native canonical grounding unresolved

accepted_class_candidates.label: serine/threonine turn
accepted_class_candidates.identifier_action: Use the exact external class under native policy; do not mint an internal surrogate.
accepted_class_candidates.definition_proposal: A three-residue structural motif whose first residue is serine or threonine and whose side-chain oxygen accepts a hydrogen bond from the backbone NH of the third residue.
accepted_class_candidates.source_rights: SO CC-BY-4.0, verified official LICENSE. BMC2009 article/supplement CC-BY-2.0, verified copyright block.
accepted_class_candidates.identity_boundary: Not equivalent to the five-residue two-bond ST motif (SO:0001126), ST staple, serine/threonine kinase sequence motif, or DSSP T-state.

detection.class_filter: Require SER/THR at the first position of a continuous three-residue segment, with its OG/OG1 side-chain oxygen accepting a backbone N-H hydrogen bond at i+2. Use actual chain adjacency and atom identities, not only integer author residue differences.
detection.subtype_filter: Eight published ST-turn SQL queries cover Ser/Thr and four geometry variants. The query framework requires source database tables; a command launching a database browser is not an arbitrary-PDB detector.
detection.shared_prerequisites: Same unexecuted HBPLUS availability/rights and coordinate-quality prerequisites as the Asx-turn card. A sequence-only S/Txx search or DSSP-only assignment cannot establish this motif.

contextual_structure_candidates.identity: Human ADM2/intermedin antagonist fragment bound to the RAMP1-CLR extracellular construct; ADM2 chains D/E/F
contextual_structure_candidates.source_claim_lead: Paper text identifies the peptide S43 side-chain to H45 backbone ST-turn. Primary article copyright block and archive metadata inspected; source body claim was surfaced in indexed primary text but full passage retrieval was CAPTCHA-limited.
contextual_structure_candidates.disposition: Deferred contextual candidate: article is under exclusive ASBMB license, not verified permissive. No imported annotation, no residue-coordinate assignment, no qualified example.
Deferred lead only: indexed primary text identifies an MtxX ST-turn, but article is CC-BY-NC-4.0; no imported annotation and no full primary-PDB verification completed.
